verdict.rationale: The pack documents an update mechanism (`npx skills update`, self-updating plugin bundles) and a triage skill users can apply to their own repos. Neither is evidence about the collection's own maintenance: there is no release history, no data on how the repo triages its issues, and no record of merged community PRs. Update plumbing and a triage feature are adjacent capabilities, not proof of active maintenance.

support.subject: As a developer, the collection is actively maintained — recent releases, triaged issues, and accepted community contributions
